subject: Path to Production: MAP approval and go-live readiness
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@healthly.co>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Recap + MAP draft (milestones & owners)

Elena — great conversation this morning. Quick recap and next steps so we have a single source of truth while your procurement and IT teams review. Thank you for walking through the scope and success criteria.

High-level takeaways:
- Priority integration: EHR sync (read-only) for patient summaries (bounded to 30 tokens per item initially).
- Target SLO: 95th percentile latency < 350ms for single-turn generation during peak.
- Success metric: 5 public-facing workflows instrumented + end-to-end latency under target for 2x typical traffic within 30 days of go-live.

I attached a draft Mutual Action Plan (Healthly_MAP_v3.xlsx) with suggested milestones, owners and dependencies. Summary below — please confirm or update owners if anything looks off:

Proposed MAP (milestones & ownership)
1) Procurement sign-off & PO issued — Owner: Elena (Healthly Procurement) — Target: 2026-12-10
2) Legal redlines complete & EULA agreed — Owner: Ava Legal (Healthly) / Ben Carter (Redwood) — Target: 2026-12-08
3) Integration readiness: API key & sandbox connectivity — Owner: Laura Bennett (Redwood SE) — Target: 2026-12-15
4) Staging validation & perf tests — Owner: Laura Bennett / Healthly engineering — Target: 2026-12-22
5) Production cutover & go-live — Owner: Healthly engineering / Redwood ops — Target: 2027-01-15

Dependencies I called out in the spreadsheet:
- Healthly to whitelist Redwood IP ranges (network team)
- PO + billing contact to finalize invoicing details
- Healthly legal to confirm data retention scope (we offered optional 30-day KV cache policy)

Next steps I propose:
- You confirm owners/timelines on the attached MAP (comment in the spreadsheet) — due: 2026-12-03
- Ben (legal) will prepare a redline-friendly summary and 1-page runbook for your security team by 2026-12-04
- Laura will schedule a 60-min sandbox demo + perf session next week (I put a tentative time in the Drive doc — please pick a slot)

Attachments: Healthly_MAP_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet), MAP_summary_v3.pdf (one-pager)

Thanks again — I’ll follow up with Ben and Laura on their action items.

Cheers,
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Thanks Marcus — helpful summary. A few quick clarifications/questions from our side: 

1) Procurement/PO timing: We are aiming to cut PO by 12/12, so the PO target in row 1 looks good but we may need an internal buffer for approvals. Can you confirm an invoicing contact and billing address?

2) Legal: Ava will lead and will push back if the data retention phrasing is not precise. Can Ben provide the specific clause text we should expect? Ava, I'll loop you in on comments in the spreadsheet.

3) Sandbox perf tests: Kevin (eng) flagged that our staging test harness runs ~10x typical token volume. Can Laura recommend a Redwood config for burst testing without falling into auto-scale charges?

We reviewed the MAP quickly and made inline comments on the Drive doc. Two asks for Redwood to help us close: 
- Please add the expected token-cost estimate for the staging perf run (Laura)
- Provide a short troubleshooting runbook for common integration failures (Ben)

If those are in place, Healthly is ready to move forward with PO + signature. We aim to be live mid-Jan; can the production target of 2027-01-15 be honored?

Elena
VP of Product
Healthly
elena@healthly.co
